title: UNITE MY HEART
PRAYER FOR GUIDANCE
end: The Morning Altar — begin every sunrise in prayer
stock_queries: sunrise over misty mountain forest landscape
early morning sunbeam shining through pine trees
calm golden sunrise over tranquil lake water
soft morning light falling on empty winding dirt road
scenic morning horizon with gentle pink clouds
golden hour light filtering through green meadow grass
peaceful morning dawn over rolling green hills

scenes.a: If your mind feels divided between two choices this morning, bring your indecision to God.
Teach me thy way, O LORD; I will walk in thy truth: unite my heart to fear thy name.
scenes.sub: TEACH ME THY WAY O LORD

scenes.a: Lord, as this morning begins, gather my scattered thoughts and calm every voice pushing me toward fear.
Show me clearly which path to take today, and steady my feet upon Your holy truth.
Unite my divided heart so that every decision I make honors You completely.
Give me single-minded faith to follow where You lead.
Subscribe to The Morning Altar to begin every sunrise in quiet prayer.
